item.description: Use a stocked productId. Run requests in order; retry async 404/409 after 1 second. Collection is ADMIN acknowledgement of real cash receipt. Re-run collection with the same key for replay. Clear COD keys/IDs to start a new order.
item.name: COD delivery and cash collection

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("codOrderKey")) { pm.collectionVariables.set("codOrderKey", pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}")); pm.collectionVariables.set("codCollectionKey", pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}")); pm.collectionVariables.set("codReceipt", "COD-" + pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}")); }

pm.test("COD accepted", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,201])); if ([200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { const data=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.paymentMethod).to.eql("COD"); pm.collectionVariables.set("codOrderId", data.id); }

pm.test("Payment ready (retry 404)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if (pm.response.code===200) { const data=pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("codPaymentId", data.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("codAmount", data.amount); }
